metrics.L0: P_min: pp_cons_roll P2naf / Pnaf_<cond>_k<k>; S1 pp_s1_mix_full_naf_m0-2
metrics.arm: L1's flags + --iroles (--rank 32 --rtclip --psupport --tscale --decouple --imode --rtransport --bbnom --bbnosize --pgate --iroles); object term retrained, target term reused from <cond>_L1 under the asserted precondition; creations k = 1, 5, 10; rollouts pp_L4_roll P2L4 / PL4_<cond>_k<k>; S1 pp_s1_mix_full_L4_m<v> for every v of the inventory
metrics.counted: familiar only: S1, OM, 3F N1 N2 N3 N4 N6 (N5 excluded: L0 fails it), S3 bottle, S3 plate
metrics.measures: pp_ladder_read.py --rung L4 (as pp_L1): OM, 3F D3 N1-N6, S3 per atom (mean over k in {1, 5, 10}); delta = L4 - L0, 2,000-draw paired state bootstrap
metrics.replaced: FC.roles (template parse + noun table) in training rows, creation and the rollout, by the lexicon of LADDER_RESULTS 5.2; a task trains iff it has a contact event and an induced parse. The read's n2_tasks roles stay the instrument
metrics.rule: a counted measure BREAKS iff |delta| > 0.10 and its CI excludes 0; L4 HOLDS iff S1 holds and no counted measure breaks, else L4 BREAKS (broken measures named); new layout and competence reported with no verdict
metrics.s1: holds iff the model's swap tests and target-into-grasp components are exactly 0 with m fixed at every inventory value on every seed AND parse locality holds on K1-K6, N1-N6 with the full lexicon
metrics.stop: L4 breaks: ladder stops for the user's decision. L4 holds: stop and report; L5 and L2/L3 are not started here. Cap: the track's 15 A40-h
metrics.written_before: any L4 rollout, S1 run or read
